3SV_FIN_CORE_ACTUALS_BS_MONTHLY_01.@EndUserText.label: Core Finance Actual Balance Sheet Monthly Aggregation
3SV_FIN_CORE_ACTUALS_BS_MONTHLY_01.@DataWarehouse.sqlEditor.query:
SELECT
  SRC."Date_CALMONTH" AS "Date_CALMONTH",
  SRC."D_XPA_COMPANY_CODE_ID" AS "D_XPA_COMPANY_CODE_ID",
  SRC."D_XPA_GL_ACCOUNT_ID" AS "D_XPA_GL_ACCOUNT_ID",
  '0L' AS "SOURCE_LEDGER",

  CASE WHEN COUNT(SRC."FISCAL_YEAR_VARIANT") = COUNT(1) AND MIN(SRC."FISCAL_YEAR_VARIANT") = MAX(SRC."FISCAL_YEAR_VARIANT")
       THEN MIN(SRC."FISCAL_YEAR_VARIANT") ELSE NULL END AS "FISCAL_YEAR_VARIANT",
  CASE WHEN COUNT(SRC."FISCAL_YEAR") = COUNT(1) AND MIN(SRC."FISCAL_YEAR") = MAX(SRC."FISCAL_YEAR")
       THEN MIN(SRC."FISCAL_YEAR") ELSE NULL END AS "FISCAL_YEAR",
  CASE WHEN COUNT(SRC."FISCAL_PERIOD") = COUNT(1) AND MIN(SRC."FISCAL_PERIOD") = MAX(SRC."FISCAL_PERIOD")
       THEN MIN(SRC."FISCAL_PERIOD") ELSE NULL END AS "FISCAL_PERIOD",
  CASE WHEN COUNT(SRC."FISCAL_YEAR_PERIOD") = COUNT(1) AND MIN(SRC."FISCAL_YEAR_PERIOD") = MAX(SRC."FISCAL_YEAR_PERIOD")
       THEN MIN(SRC."FISCAL_YEAR_PERIOD") ELSE NULL END AS "FISCAL_YEAR_PERIOD",
  CASE WHEN COUNT(SRC."FISCAL_PERIOD_START_DATE") = COUNT(1) AND MIN(SRC."FISCAL_PERIOD_START_DATE") = MAX(SRC."FISCAL_PERIOD_START_DATE")
       THEN MIN(SRC."FISCAL_PERIOD_START_DATE") ELSE NULL END AS "FISCAL_PERIOD_START_DATE",
  CASE WHEN COUNT(SRC."FISCAL_PERIOD_END_DATE") = COUNT(1) AND MIN(SRC."FISCAL_PERIOD_END_DATE") = MAX(SRC."FISCAL_PERIOD_END_DATE")
       THEN MIN(SRC."FISCAL_PERIOD_END_DATE") ELSE NULL END AS "FISCAL_PERIOD_END_DATE",
  CASE WHEN COUNT(SRC."ACCOUNT_CLASS") = COUNT(1) AND MIN(SRC."ACCOUNT_CLASS") = MAX(SRC."ACCOUNT_CLASS")
       THEN MIN(SRC."ACCOUNT_CLASS") ELSE NULL END AS "ACCOUNT_CLASS",
  CASE WHEN COUNT(SRC."REPORTING_SIGN_FACTOR") = COUNT(1) AND MIN(SRC."REPORTING_SIGN_FACTOR") = MAX(SRC."REPORTING_SIGN_FACTOR")
       THEN MIN(SRC."REPORTING_SIGN_FACTOR") ELSE NULL END AS "REPORTING_SIGN_FACTOR",

  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(SRC."FISCAL_YEAR_VARIANT") = COUNT(1) AND MIN(SRC."FISCAL_YEAR_VARIANT") = MAX(SRC."FISCAL_YEAR_VARIANT")
     AND COUNT(SRC."FISCAL_YEAR") = COUNT(1) AND MIN(SRC."FISCAL_YEAR") = MAX(SRC."FISCAL_YEAR")
     AND COUNT(SRC."FISCAL_PERIOD") = COUNT(1) AND MIN(SRC."FISCAL_PERIOD") = MAX(SRC."FISCAL_PERIOD")
     AND COUNT(SRC."FISCAL_YEAR_PERIOD") = COUNT(1) AND MIN(SRC."FISCAL_YEAR_PERIOD") = MAX(SRC."FISCAL_YEAR_PERIOD")
     AND COUNT(SRC."FISCAL_PERIOD_START_DATE") = COUNT(1) AND MIN(SRC."FISCAL_PERIOD_START_DATE") = MAX(SRC."FISCAL_PERIOD_START_DATE")
     AND COUNT(SRC."FISCAL_PERIOD_END_DATE") = COUNT(1) AND MIN(SRC."FISCAL_PERIOD_END_DATE") = MAX(SRC."FISCAL_PERIOD_END_DATE")
     AND COUNT(SRC."ACCOUNT_CLASS") = COUNT(1) AND MIN(SRC."ACCOUNT_CLASS") = MAX(SRC."ACCOUNT_CLASS")
     AND COUNT(SRC."REPORTING_SIGN_FACTOR") = COUNT(1) AND MIN(SRC."REPORTING_SIGN_FACTOR") = MAX(SRC."REPORTING_SIGN_FACTOR")
      THEN 'CONFORMANT'
    ELSE 'INCONSISTENT_MAPPING_ATTRIBUTES'
  END AS "AGGREGATION_CONFORMANCE_STATUS",

  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(SRC."FISCAL_YEAR_VARIANT") = COUNT(1) AND MIN(SRC."FISCAL_YEAR_VARIANT") = MAX(SRC."FISCAL_YEAR_VARIANT")
     AND COUNT(SRC."FISCAL_YEAR") = COUNT(1) AND MIN(SRC."FISCAL_YEAR") = MAX(SRC."FISCAL_YEAR")
     AND COUNT(SRC."FISCAL_PERIOD") = COUNT(1) AND MIN(SRC."FISCAL_PERIOD") = MAX(SRC."FISCAL_PERIOD")
     AND COUNT(SRC."FISCAL_YEAR_PERIOD") = COUNT(1) AND MIN(SRC."FISCAL_YEAR_PERIOD") = MAX(SRC."FISCAL_YEAR_PERIOD")
     AND COUNT(SRC."FISCAL_PERIOD_START_DATE") = COUNT(1) AND MIN(SRC."FISCAL_PERIOD_START_DATE") = MAX(SRC."FISCAL_PERIOD_START_DATE")
     AND COUNT(SRC."FISCAL_PERIOD_END_DATE") = COUNT(1) AND MIN(SRC."FISCAL_PERIOD_END_DATE") = MAX(SRC."FISCAL_PERIOD_END_DATE")
     AND COUNT(SRC."ACCOUNT_CLASS") = COUNT(1) AND MIN(SRC."ACCOUNT_CLASS") = MAX(SRC."ACCOUNT_CLASS")
     AND COUNT(SRC."REPORTING_SIGN_FACTOR") = COUNT(1) AND MIN(SRC."REPORTING_SIGN_FACTOR") = MAX(SRC."REPORTING_SIGN_FACTOR")
      THEN CASE
             WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN SRC."SIGN_CONFORMANCE_STATUS" = 'UNCLASSIFIED_GL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'UNCLASSIFIED_GL'
             WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN SRC."SIGN_CONFORMANCE_STATUS" = 'INVALID_SIGN_RULE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'INVALID_SIGN_RULE'
             WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN SRC."SIGN_CONFORMANCE_STATUS" = 'MISSING_SIGN_RULE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'MISSING_SIGN_RULE'
             WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN SRC."SIGN_CONFORMANCE_STATUS" = 'SIGNED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = COUNT(1) THEN 'SIGNED'
             ELSE 'INVALID_SIGN_RULE'
           END
    ELSE 'INVALID_SIGN_RULE'
  END AS "SIGN_CONFORMANCE_STATUS",

  COUNT(1) AS "SOURCE_RECORD_COUNT",
  SUM(SRC."MEAS_FLOW_CHANGING_RAW") AS "MEAS_FLOW_CHANGING_RAW",
  SUM(SRC."MEAS_FLOW_CHANGING") AS "MEAS_FLOW_CHANGING"
FROM "3SV_FIN_CORE_ACTUALS_SIGNED_MONTHLY_01" SRC
WHERE SRC."ACCOUNT_CLASS" IN ('ASSET', 'LIABILITY', 'EQUITY')
GROUP BY SRC."Date_CALMONTH", SRC."D_XPA_COMPANY_CODE_ID", SRC."D_XPA_GL_ACCOUNT_ID"
